Drums feature a tight, dry snare sound with ghost notes and a crisp hi-hat playing 16th-note patterns. A wah-wah pedal effect is applied to a secondary rhythm guitar. The arrangement includes occasional brass stabs from a trumpet and saxophone section. Tempo is 115 BPM in the key of E minor.
